items.source: Abstract builder class to support the construction of table specifications that have table options, that is, those options normally specified by WITH ... AND ....
items.translation: 抽象构建器类，用于支持具有表选项的表规范构造，即通常由 `WITH ... AND ...` 指定的那些选项。

items.translation: 用于配置ALTER KEYSPACE规范的实体。

items.source: Object to configure a CREATE KEYSPACE specification.
items.translation: 用于配置CREATE KEYSPACE规范的参数对象。
